title: Croatian-Style Smoked Turkey Neck Hash
description: A hearty, smoky hash dish made with slow-cooked turkey neck and a blend of Croatian spices. Serve as a satisfying breakfast or brunch option.
instructions: Season the turkey neck with smoked salt, black pepper, and Croatian paprika.
Smoke the turkey neck for 4-5 hours, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Meanwhile, hash the browned potatoes and onions in a pan until crispy.
Shred the cooked turkey neck into bite-sized pieces.
To assemble the hash, layer the shredded turkey, hash browns, fermented red cabbage slaw, and quick pickled onions in a serving dish.
